review.subject: Ceramic vase and flower collection with named variants
review.summary: A beige studio shows one vase with flowers at a time, each labelled with an Italian place name in small white text, crossfading from one to the next every ~2s. It ends on a group shot of all vases on stepped risers with a small logo; the measured long first shot is really many dissolves.

beats.note: Eight vase-and-flower sets cross-dissolve, each with a place-name label in a different corner.
All vases staged together on risers with a small logo at the top and brand mark at the bottom.

shot_labels.note: Single vase with flowers, name label, dissolve to next
Group of all vases on risers with logo

learn: Show one SKU per 1.5-2s on an identical neutral set so only the product changes.
Cross-dissolve instead of cutting; the 12s single measured shot is a chain of soft dissolves.
Label each SKU with small white caps text that fades in and shifts position slightly.
Keep camera nearly static (easeOut push at most) so the products carry the motion.
Finish with a 3s group lineup and logo as the payoff after the singles.

shots.move: dolly-zoom (vertigo) candidate + push-in + pan right (content moves right)
